title: Heated Stone for Hypixel Skyblock
description: Shows where the magma fields start in the crystal hollows on hypixel skyblock / HSB
body:
This pack is made to help indecate where the magma fields stop and start visually without having to check the f3 screen. It does so by having an animated first layer showing where it is safe to be and more colored layers showing u go deeper

requires CTM mod like continuity
